defects.problem: Real seed paths contain a colon in the composition identity; the original generic path grammar rejected them.
defects.fix: Bind exactly six canonical composition paths and three approved evidence routes before pair use or lease acquisition.

defects.problem: Original1GiB source cap rejected a potential qualified1.5B Q8 model.
defects.fix: Use the existing2GiB hosted-model bound and narrower member/evidence caps; actual model qualification and device limits remain separate.

defects.problem: Two simultaneous requests for expired metadata could return503 for the lock loser even when the first request successfully renewed.
defects.fix: Wait at most30seconds only when existing metadata is expired, then revalidate the current pair after acquiring the local lock.

validation.coverage: Pinned PHP runtime lacks coverage instrumentation; actual branch scenarios are retained without a numeric coverage claim.
validation.timeoutLimit: Actual lock contention and immediate-current fallback tested; the full30-second timeout duration is not measured.
validation.largeSizeBoundary: 2GiB boundary is metadata-only. No large synthetic payload or performance claim.

failurePreservation: First new closure test run reproduced concurrent503. Raw failure is unchanged; second run passes after bounded-lock fix.

independentReview.reviewer: hosting implementation agent, separate from root author
independentReview.result: No material blocker found in exact source closure, source hash/inode checks, or bounded lock revalidation.

production.remaining: Publisher integration, real qualified seed/evidence, distinct private namespace denial, public actual renewal and expiration monitoring.
